messages.title: First Contact
messages.body:
…if anyone is out there, we made it to the ridge.

The storm took the eastern tower but the beacon is holding. We can see lights on the far shore — no idea whose.

Listening on 92.4. If you hear this, respond.

messages.title: Supplies
messages.body:
…canned goods and fuel are still in the bunker under the school. Codes are the same as always.

We're down to four. Two of us are sick. The others won't say how bad.

If you're coming, come soon.

messages.title: Do Not Respond
messages.body:
…whoever you are, stop transmitting. They're listening on every band. Every frequency you try is a beacon.

Turn the radio off. Don't answer anyone.

This is the last message I can send.
